items.text: Archie is on screen.
James is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie, James.
Exactly two men are in the room: Archie and James, no one else.
Archie and James are placed in the same spots as in james_meeting_8.png.
Archie's face is turned toward the camera, not toward James.
Archie's eyebrows are visibly raised.
Archie's expression looks like he is waiting for an answer, with an open, expectant face.
James is leaning on the workshop bench.
James is not facing the camera. He is looking at Archie or off to the side.
The workshop room matches james_workshop_blank_plate.png, with the bench, shelves and tools unchanged.
No new props appear, such as a bag, suitcase, phone or papers, in either man's hands or in the room.
Both men are fully visible and not cropped by the image edges.
Camera angle and composition match james_workshop_blank_plate.png and james_meeting_8.png.
Archie and James are drawn at the same pixel scale as the room, neither oversized nor tiny.
Image dimensions match the blank plate exactly.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
